question: How do I set up a payment plan for spring semester tuition? and is there a fee to enroll in it

For cap and gown (graduate regalia), email the Bookstore at bookstore@ramapo.edu. [2]

question: Should I do a master's right after graduating or work for a year first? what would you recommend
answer:
The pages don’t give a recommendation between starting a master’s immediately and working for a year; that’s a personal decision. [2] They say employers look for work experience, and that “Your job experience will” help you get a job. [3] They recommend getting co-op or internship experience before graduating. [4]

For planning, the career center suggests exploring graduate programs, attending workshops and completing required admission tests in junior year; in senior year, finalize and send graduate applications by their deadlines. [6][5] Ramapo offers graduate programs in fields including Nursing, Business, Data Science, Education, Social Work and Music Technology. [8]

For help weighing career options, contact the Cahill Career Development Center: careercenter@ramapo.edu, (201) 684-7444 (Main Office) or (201) 684-7675 (ASB Office). [5][6] For graduate-program information, contact Admissions: admissions@ramapo.edu, (201) 684-7300. [8]

Sources: [2](https://www.ramapo.edu/studentsuccess/major/) [3](https://www.ramapo.edu/studentsuccess/major/) [4](https://www.ramapo.edu/studentsuccess/major/) [5](https://www.ramapo.edu/careercenter/four-year-plan/) [6](https://www.ramapo.edu/careercenter/four-year-plan/) [8](https://www.ramapo.edu/learn/graduate/)
